name: Loose Prints
description: Photo prints scattered on a surface that you can pick up, throw against the edges and pile on top of each other.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the surface. Its box is the bounds the prints stay inside, so give it a size.

props.name: children
props.description: LoosePrint elements, and anything to show behind them.

props.name: initial
props.type: { x: number; y: number; rotate: number }
props.description: Starting offset from the centre of the container, in pixels, and angle in degrees. Without it the print takes a seeded position and angle. Prints are kept inside the bounds when the container resizes.

props.name: caption
props.description: Text written in the wide bottom margin of the print.

props.name: children
props.description: The photo. Give it a width; the print wraps it with a narrow border.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the print, which is focusable. Arrow keys move the focused print, Shift moves it further.
